Description:
You feel everything deeply yet stay grounded and calm. Others trust your emotional steadiness.

Your wisdom comes from matching your inner and outer worlds with clarity and authenticity.
Shadow Side: Can become overly responsible for others’ emotions, suppressing their own needs to maintain calm.
Growth Path: Practice sharing your own emotional needs rather than only supporting others.
Citations: Tomkins, S. (1962). Affect Imagery Consciousness.; Ekman, P. (1992). An argument for basic emotions.; Izard, C. (1977). Human Emotions.; Nathanson, D. (1992). Shame and Pride.
